title: Decent Fold Up Rack - but a Word of Caution
text:
Decent Fold Up Rack - but a Word of Caution. We hung this within our laundry as a place to hang laundry as it comes from the dryer to complete drying.

The brushed nickel finish looks nice and installation is straightforward. I do like how it folds flat when not in use.

My complaint with this product is there is no way to lock the bar in place when hanging clothes so when it is actually in use the hanging bar can tend to move around and has fallen out of the brackets to the floor. This could be easily resolved with a simple plastic clip.

While this is an OK product it is one I have found I must be careful when using in order to not end up having all of our clean clothes on the floor.
